what: Several layers stuck behind the screen (full-bleed photos, solid color planes) overlap, and the page’s section (data-backdrop="<Floor name>") once it passes the start line (default: section top at 70% of the screen), that layer turns on over 1s ease — later layers sit on top, so the earlier layer stays on but covered, and scrolling back above the start line turns that layer off so the earlier one shows again. Leave a photo section empty and the photo behind looks like a window, and when a text section is reached the same layer is tinted a solid color

options.sections: Selector of sections that switch layers, default [data-backdrop] — a section’s data-backdrop value is the layer’s data-key
options.start: Trigger line, default top 70% — change it per section via data-backdrop-start
options.end: End line (turns off once passed), default bottom -50% — data-backdrop-end per section
options.narrow: At window widths of this many px or less, use the section’s data-backdrop-start-narrow·data-backdrop-end-narrow, default 800
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Layers (several children, named by data-key). Document order is the stacking order. The layer with data-base (or the first one if none) is on from the start

use: …

from.where: index.html .gl-back — original .section-back div (opacity 1s transition), 6 photos and 4 solid colors, each with ScrollTrigger toggleClass on (start top 70%·50%·30%, on phones the photo cell top 150px, end bottom -50%)
